headline: Minimal-Group Paradigm · Tajfel 1970–1979

items.title: Experimental Baseline
items.detail: Henri Tajfel's 1970s laboratory studies isolated the minimum trigger for group bias.

items.title: Arbitrary Criterion Split
items.detail: Subjects sorted by Klee versus Kandinsky preference or dot-estimation guesses.

items.title: Zero Structural Confounds
items.detail: No face-to-face contact, no shared history, and no personal financial stake.

items.title: Maximum Payoff Differential
items.detail: Subjects systematically favored ingroup members and maximized relative outgroup gap.

items.title: Automatic Boundary Reflex
items.detail: Establishes the default cognitive operation triggered by any group boundary label.

items.title: Institutional Capture (§2.1)
items.detail: Political-economic systems capture that reflex and scale it into a five-tier machine.

sources: Tajfel (1970); Tajfel & Turner (1979); The Original Power, Preface & §2.3.4
